faq.title: FAQ
faq.description: Answers to common questions about using Edge.

items.question: What is Edge?
items.answer: Edge is a digital signage platform for managing screens, playlists, and media within an organization. Everything you do in the app is scoped to the organization selected in the sidebar.

items.question: How do I get started after signing up?
items.answer: If you registered without an invitation, you are asked to create your first organization before accessing the dashboard. If you joined through an invite, you are added to that organization automatically and can start using the app right away.

items.question: What does the dashboard show?
items.answer: The dashboard gives you a quick overview of your active organization: how many screens you have (and how many are online), how many playlists exist, and how many media files are uploaded. Each card links to the relevant section.

items.question: Can I change the app language or theme?
items.answer: Yes. Open Settings → Preferences to switch between English and Serbian, and to choose light, dark, or system theme. Language preference is saved to your account when the API is available.

items.question: How do I add and connect a screen?
items.answer: Go to Screens and register a new display. Open the screen’s Connect tab to see a pairing code and step-by-step instructions. Enter that code on the physical display to link it to your organization. Once online, you can assign playlists from the screen’s Content tab.

items.question: How do playlists work?
items.answer: Playlists are ordered collections of media. Create one under Playlists, add items from your media library, adjust order and duration, then assign the playlist to one or more screens.

items.question: Where do I upload media?
items.answer: Open Media in the sidebar to upload images and videos. Uploaded files belong to your active organization and can be added to playlists from the playlist editor.

items.question: How do I know if a screen is online?
items.answer: Screens show an online or offline status on the Screens list and on the dashboard stats. The Connect tab also reflects whether the display is currently reachable.

items.question: What is an organization?
items.answer: An organization is the workspace that owns your screens, playlists, media, and team members. All content and users are managed per organization. You can belong to multiple organizations with a separate role in each.

items.question: How do I switch between organizations?
items.answer: Use the organization switcher at the top of the sidebar. Click an organization name to make it active. The rest of the app — including Users, screens, and media — updates to show data for that organization.

items.question: Who can create, edit, or delete organizations?
items.answer: Only admins can create a new organization from the switcher, rename an organization, or delete one. Members can switch between organizations they belong to but cannot manage them.

items.question: Why can’t I delete an organization?
items.answer: You cannot delete your only remaining organization — at least one must stay on your account. You also cannot delete the organization that is currently active; switch to another one first. Deleting an organization removes it for all members.

items.question: What roles are available?
items.answer: Each organization has admins and members. Admins can invite and manage users and manage the organization itself. Members can use the app (screens, playlists, media) but cannot invite users or change organization settings.

items.question: How do I invite someone?
items.answer: Admins can open Users from the account menu at the bottom of the sidebar, click Invite user, and enter the person’s name, email, and role. They appear in the list with a Pending status until they complete the invitation flow.

items.question: What happens when I invite someone who does not have an account?
items.answer: They receive an email with a link to the registration page. Their email is pre-filled and locked to the invited address. After they create an account, they join your organization automatically and skip the create-organization step.

items.question: What happens when I invite someone who already has an account?
items.answer: They receive an email with a link to review the invitation. If they are not signed in, they are taken to the login page first, then shown a dialog to accept or decline. If they are already signed in with the invited email, the dialog appears immediately.

items.question: What do Approved and Pending mean in the users table?
items.answer: Approved means the person is an active member of the organization. Pending means the invitation was sent but not yet accepted — either they have not finished registration (new user) or have not accepted the invite (existing user).

items.question: Can one person belong to multiple organizations?
items.answer: Yes. A single account can be a member of many organizations, potentially with different roles in each. Use the organization switcher to move between them.

items.question: How do I update my profile?
items.answer: Go to Settings → Profile to change your name, phone number, and company. Your email address is tied to your login and cannot be changed from the profile form.

items.question: I signed in with Google. Can I also use a password?
items.answer: Yes. If you registered with Google and have no app password yet, open Settings → Security and use Set password. After that you can sign in with either Google or your email and password.

items.question: How do I reset a forgotten password?
items.answer: On the login page, click Forgot your password?, enter your email, and follow the link sent to your inbox. The reset link expires after a limited time. This only works for accounts that were created with an email and password.

items.question: What happens when I delete my account?
items.answer: Deleting your account is permanent. Your user record is removed. For each organization you belonged to: if you were the only member, the organization is deleted; otherwise only your membership is removed. You can delete your account from Settings → Account.

items.question: How do I send feedback or report a problem?
items.answer: Open Settings → Help. Use Leave feedback to rate your experience and share comments, or Report a problem to describe something that is not working. Messages are sent to the Edge support team with your account and active organization details.

items.question: Where can I find these answers again?
items.answer: This FAQ page is always available from the account menu at the bottom of the sidebar, next to Settings and Users.
